title: Perceptual reality monitoring: awareness is a judgment that a percept is real

statements.text: In Lau's variant, a first-order representation becomes conscious when a higher-order process judges it to be a statistically reliable perceptual signal, rather than noise or imagination. A poorly activated higher-order process can still make false alarms, so low activity there need not mean low awareness.
statements.scope: Stated here through Lau and Rosenthal 2011, Block 2011 and Gershman 2019. Lau 2008 and Lau 2019, which state the view in full, are not among the sources read.

sources.quote: When a first-order representation is 'judged' by a higher-order decision process to constitute a statistically reliable perceptual signal
Thus low activity in the higher-order process does not necessarily mean low level of awareness.
a higher order probabilistic 'pointer' that has no content of its own refers to a first order representation
